There is a lot of confusion on linear vs. log scale charting.

1) You can't chart long-term price action on linear scale.
2) Even if you are using log scale, price target calculations can be performed as below and you will be fine.

Log scale upward break:

Take the absolute price difference between boundaries and add it to the upper boundary.

Log scale downward break:

Take the % change between the boundaries and subtract it in % terms from the lower boundary.

Both will give you a conservative price objective.

Swing low inside a pattern can be utilized as the last important stop level.
